problem.title: The role is new – the expectations are big right away.
problem.intro: You are strong on the craft. But leadership asks for something else: decisions under uncertainty, clear communication and a stance when things get uncomfortable.
points: You make decisions, then keep doubting them long after.
You postpone hard conversations instead of leading them clearly.
You are caught in day-to-day work and lose sight of the direction.
You want to show authority without pretending to be someone else – and don't know how.

items.title: Clarity
items.description: You know what matters to you and make decisions you can stand behind.

items.title: Communication
items.description: You address expectations, feedback and conflict calmly and directly.

items.title: Leadership
items.description: You lead from a stance that fits you – committed, not tense.

method.title: A clear path instead of loose tips
method.intro: We work in four steps that build on each other – concrete and aligned with your real situations.

steps.title: Locate your position
steps.description: We look honestly at your current role, your strengths and what holds you back.

steps.title: Spot the patterns
steps.description: We surface the thinking and behaviour patterns that slow you down as a leader.

steps.title: Develop strategies
steps.description: You develop concrete options for your recurring situations.

steps.title: Support the rollout
steps.description: You apply it day to day, and we adjust together until it feels right.

offer.title: The 8-week Leadership Reset Coaching
offer.description: A focused 1:1 programme for your start into the leadership role – with room to reflect and clear steps for everyday work.
includes: Eight 1:1 sessions (60 minutes each) every two weeks
Personal position check at the start
Concrete tools for conversations, decisions and prioritisation
Personal closing summary with next steps
suitable: New leaders in their first 18 months
Experts about to step into leadership
Team leads who want to show up with more confidence
offer.noPriceNote: We define the scope individually in the free intro call – tailored to your situation.

items.question: Who is this coaching for?
items.answer: For new and aspiring leaders who want to shape their role deliberately – regardless of industry or team size.

items.question: How do the sessions work?
items.answer: The eight sessions take place online via video, every two weeks, with 60 minutes for your topic each time.

items.question: What if I get stuck in between?
items.answer: Between sessions you have a short sparring option to quickly make sense of urgent situations.

items.question: Do I need leadership experience already?
items.answer: No. The programme fits both before your first leadership step and in the first months of the new role.
